name: Question 11
worked_solution:
Here, we combine the sum rule and our exponential rules to get

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\int (5{e}^{x}+{2}^{x})\,\text{d}x & =5\int {e}^{x}\,\text{d}x+\int {2}^{x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =5{e}^{x}+\frac{{2}^{x}}{ln⁡2}+C.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
